title: Prepositions of place
grammarNote:
Предлоги места (Prepositions of place) — это слова, которые показывают, ГДЕ находится человек, предмет или место. В казахском языке им соответствуют послелоги (-да/-де/-та/-те для "в/на", -дың/-нің жанында для "рядом с"). В русском — предлоги "в", "на", "у", "рядом с", "между", "напротив" и другие.

Три самых важных предлога: IN, ON, AT

📍 IN — внутри чего-то, в ограниченном пространстве:
"The students are IN the library." (студенты внутри здания)
"Almaty is IN the south-east of Kazakhstan." (город IN стране)
"There are flowers IN the garden." (цветы IN саду)

📍 ON — на поверхности чего-то, с физическим контактом:
"Put your bag ON the desk." (сумка лежит ON столе — поверхность)
"The café is ON the second floor." (кафе ON этаже здания)
"We live ON Gogol Street." (ON улице — улица как поверхность)

📍 AT — конкретная точка, место или адрес:
"We met AT the station." (в конкретной точке — станция)
"I study AT WKU." (в учреждении — AT используем для организаций)
"She was AT the bus stop." (AT = у конкретного места)

⚠️ ТИПИЧНЫЕ ОШИБКИ казахстанских студентов:
❌ "I am in the bus stop." → ✅ "I am AT the bus stop."
❌ "The book is at the table." → ✅ "The book is ON the table."
❌ "She lives in 15 Abay Street." → ✅ "She lives AT 15 Abay Street." (адрес = AT)

💡 ДРУГИЕ ПРЕДЛОГИ МЕСТА:
NEXT TO / BESIDE = рядом с (вплотную):
"The café is next to the bookshop."

BETWEEN = между (двумя вещами):
"The mausoleum stands between two old trees."

OPPOSITE = напротив (прямо лицом к лицу):
"The post office is opposite the park."

ABOVE = над (выше, но не обязательно касаясь):
"The lamp is above the table."

BELOW / UNDER = ниже / под:
"Put your bag under the seat." (под = физически под)
"The city is below the mountains." (ниже в рельефе)

BEHIND = позади, за:
"The bazaar is behind the post office."

IN FRONT OF = перед, спереди:
"We took photos in front of the cathedral."

NEAR = рядом с, недалеко от (расстояние):
"The hotel is near the station."

AROUND = вокруг:
"Children were playing around the fountain."

grammarExtra.title: ① IN — внутри пространства, городов, стран, комнат

rows.example: "The professor is IN the lecture room." · "There are 50 books IN the bag." · "She waited IN the corridor."
"Almaty is IN Kazakhstan." · "WKU is IN Uralsk." · "The resort is IN the mountains." · "She grew up IN the south."
"The café is IN the airport building." · "They met IN the library." · "The information desk is IN the corner."

rows.form: ⚠️ НЕ путай с AT для организаций:
rows.example: ❌ "I study in WKU." → ✅ "I study AT WKU." (организации, учреждения → AT, не IN!)
"The park is IN the centre of Almaty." · "She lives IN the north of the city." · "The market is IN the old part of town."
"They walked IN the park." · "The resort is IN the forest." · "Children played IN the garden."

grammarExtra.title: ② ON — на поверхности, этажах, улицах, транспорте

rows.example: "The map is ON the wall." · "Your phone is ON the desk." · "The cat is ON the chair."
"The departure gates are ON the second floor." · "The café is ON the ground floor." · "My room is ON the third floor."
"We walked ON Zhibek Zholy Street." · "The library is ON Lenin Avenue." · "Turn left ON Abay Street."
"We were ON the bus." · "She was ON the train to Almaty." · "Fly ON the plane to Astana."
"The timetable is ON the board." · "My photo is ON the screen." · "The information is ON the departures board."
"The library is ON your right." · "The spices are ON the left side of the bazaar." · "The museum is ON the south side."

grammarExtra.title: ③ AT — конкретная точка, адрес, организация, событие

rows.example: "I study AT WKU." · "She works AT the hospital." · "He trains AT the sports centre."
"We met AT the station." · "Kamila was AT the airport." · "Wait for me AT the bus stop."
"She lives AT 42 Gogol Street." · "The office is AT 15 Abay Avenue." · "Meet me AT the main entrance."
"I was AT the conference." · "She is AT a wedding today." · "We met AT the debate competition."
"There is a fountain AT the bottom of the steps." · "We stood AT the top of the mountain." · "Sign AT the bottom of the page."
"I am AT the library" (= at the location) vs "I am IN the library" (= inside the building). Оба правильны — разный акцент!

grammarExtra.title: ④ BETWEEN, OPPOSITE, NEXT TO, ABOVE, BEHIND — позиция

rows.example: "Sit next to me." · "The shop is next to the café." · "There is a bus stop next to the park gates."
"The park is between Gogol Street and Kabar Avenue." · "I sat between Aibek and Kamila at dinner."
"The post office is opposite the park." · "We sat opposite each other." · "The mosque is opposite the mausoleum."
"Lamps hang above the stalls." (выше, не касается) · "Your bag is below the seat." (ниже) · "The city is below the mountains."

rows.form: BEHIND vs IN FRONT OF (за / перед):
rows.example: "The bazaar is behind the post office." · "We stood in front of the cathedral and took photos."
"The hotel is near the station." (недалеко) vs "Children ran around the fountain." (по кругу вокруг)

grammarTip:
Три шага — и предлог места всегда правильный:

① Задай себе вопрос "КАК расположен предмет?":
   Внутри чего-то? → IN ("in the bag", "in Kazakhstan")
   На поверхности? → ON ("on the desk", "on the second floor")
   У конкретной точки? → AT ("at the station", "at WKU")

② Запомни через сцены из урока:
   Madina was IN Almaty (в городе) ✅
   She stood IN FRONT OF the cathedral ✅
   The bazaar is BEHIND the post office ✅
   The gates are ON the second floor ✅
   She waited AT the airport ✅

③ Проверь себя — предложения-ловушки:
   ❌ "I am in the bus stop." → ✅ AT the bus stop
   ❌ "The book is at the table." → ✅ ON the table
   ❌ "She works in the hospital." → ✅ AT the hospital (организация!)

💡 Подсказка: если можешь "войти внутрь" — скорее всего IN или AT. Если "лежит сверху" — ON. Если "конкретная точка или место встречи" — AT.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition of place.
exercises.text: The WKU library is ___ Uralsk, in the west of Kazakhstan.
exercises.hint: Города, страны, регионы → IN. "Uralsk is IN the west of Kazakhstan." ✅

exercises.text: The departure gates are all ___ the second floor — take the stairs after security.
exercises.hint: Этажи здания → ON. "The café is ON the ground floor." · "The gates are ON the second floor." ✅

exercises.text: Kamila waited for Aibek ___ the main entrance of the airport.
exercises.hint: Конкретная точка встречи → AT. "Meet me AT the entrance." · "Wait AT the bus stop." ✅

exercises.text: "The Zenkov Cathedral stands opposite the fountain in Panfilov Park" means the cathedral and the fountain face each other directly.
exercises.hint: OPPOSITE = напротив, лицом к лицу. "The post office is opposite the park." — они смотрят друг на друга. ✅

exercises.text: Panfilov Park is ___ Gogol Street and Kabar Avenue — one avenue on each side.
exercises.hint: BETWEEN = между двумя вещами. "The park is BETWEEN two avenues." ✅ (Opposite = напротив одного; Between = между двумя!)

exercises.text: Damir put his notebook ___ the seat so it would not fall off the train.
exercises.hint: Физически ниже, под поверхностью → UNDER. "Put your bag UNDER the seat." ✅ (Below = более общее "ниже"; Under = конкретно "под".)

exercises.text: Above the market stalls, colourful lamps ___ the ceiling made the whole bazaar feel warm.
exercises.hint: Лампы висели ВЫШЕ над прилавками → ABOVE. "The lamps were ABOVE the stalls, hanging from the ceiling." ✅

exercises.text: "She lives next to the park" and "She lives near the park" mean exactly the same thing.
exercises.hint: NEXT TO = вплотную рядом (immediate, touching/adjacent). NEAR = недалеко (some distance away). "Next to" ближе, чем "near"! They are similar but not identical.
